# Limit of detection with the prolfqua::MissingHelpers class


```{r lookAtSummarizeStats}
dd <- prolfqua::sim_lfq_data_protein_config(Nprot = 100,weight_missing = 2)
dd$data$abundance |> is.na() |> sum()

mh1 <- prolfqua::MissingHelpers$new(dd$data, dd$config, prob = 0.5)
head(mh1$get_stats())
mh1$get_lod()
```


## Modelling with linear models


Model with missing data

```{r lmModel}
modelName <- "f_condtion_r_peptide"
formula_Protein <-
  prolfqua::strategy_lm("abundance  ~ group_",
              model_name = modelName)


dd_lfq <- prolfqua::LFQData$new(dd$data, dd$config)
mod <- prolfqua::build_model(
  dd_lfq,
  formula_Protein,
  model_name = modelName)

mod$model_df
mod$model_df$nr_coef_not_NA |> table()

mod$model_df$isSingular |> table()
mod$model_df |> nrow()
mod$get_anova()
prolfqua::model_summary(mod)

maxcoef <- max(mod$model_df$nr_coef_not_NA, na.rm = TRUE)
goodmods <- mod$model_df |> dplyr::filter(isSingular == FALSE, has_model_fit == TRUE, nr_coef_not_NA == maxcoef)

dim(goodmods)
xx <- lapply(goodmods$linear_model, vcov)
nr <- sapply(xx, nrow)
nr |> table()
nr <- sapply(xx, ncol)
nr |> table()

sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, xx)
sum_matrix/length(xx)


```



# Model with lod imputation

```{r lmod2}
loddata <- dd$data

loddata <- loddata |> dplyr::mutate(abundance = ifelse(is.na(abundance), mh1$get_lod(), abundance))
modI <- prolfqua::build_model(
  loddata,
  formula_Protein,
  model_name = modelName,
  subject_id = dd_lfq$relevant_hierarchy_keys())


modI$model_df$nr_coef_not_NA |> table()
modI$model_df$isSingular |> table()
modI$model_df |> nrow()

allModels <- modI$model_df$linear_model

xx <- lapply(allModels, vcov)
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, xx)
sum_matrix/length(xx)


```


```{r inspect_imputed_model}
m <- (modI$model_df$linear_model[[1]])
df.residual(m)
sigma(m)
vcov(m)

```

# Filling missing cells from the protein models

`impute_from_model()` completes the data to every protein x sample and fills each missing cell with `predict()` of that protein's fitted model. A protein fitted on its observed values takes the route `fitted`; one that `build_model_impute()` refitted at the LOD, typically because a whole group is missing, takes `lod_refit`. Observed values stay as they are, and the filled values carry no noise.

```{r imputeFromModel}
modImpute <- prolfqua::build_model_impute(dd_lfq, formula_Protein)
filled <- prolfqua::impute_from_model(modImpute, dd_lfq)
filled$summary$route |> table()

before <- dd_lfq$data_long()
after <- filled$lfqdata$data_long()
missing_cells <- dplyr::inner_join(
  before |> dplyr::filter(is.na(abundance)) |> dplyr::select(protein_Id, sampleName, group_),
  after |> dplyr::select(protein_Id, sampleName, filled = abundance),
  by = c("protein_Id", "sampleName")
)
head(missing_cells)
```
